title: Agentic AI Engineering
subtitle: Designing, Evaluating, and Operating Systems That Act
description: A professional field book for converting justified model-directed autonomy into bounded, inspectable, evaluable, recoverable action across tools, state, people, and production systems.
author: Komal Nakrani

chapters.title: The Profession Behind the Agent
chapters.summary: Define Agentic AI Engineering by responsibility for bounded action and separate model, harness, product, platform, domain, and authority decisions.

chapters.title: Earn the Right to Use Autonomy
chapters.summary: Compare fixed, assisted, single-agent, and multi-agent execution against one task and choose the least complex adequate level.

chapters.title: Contract the Goal, Actions, and Authority
chapters.summary: Turn a vague delegated request into a machine-checkable contract for completion, actions, effects, budgets, approval, stop, escalation, and evidence.
